name: Capsicum
perishability: Perishable. About a week at room temperature; 2–3 weeks at 7–10 °C.
summary: A mild pepper grown in the field in Karnataka and the hills, and increasingly under polyhouses (red and yellow bell peppers) around Pune, Bengaluru and in Haryana and Punjab. Demand comes from restaurants, Chinese and Indian food service, and pizza chains as much as from homes.

key_numbers.label: Coloured peppers
key_numbers.note: red and yellow sell at 4–8× green on quick commerce

global: India grows capsicum mainly for home use; small volumes go to the Gulf, UK and Nepal.

states.basis: Major producing states (ranked approximately; shares not shown)

belts.name: Bengaluru–Chikkaballapur
belts.note: Year-round field and polyhouse crop; ships nationwide.

belts.name: Pune polyhouse cluster
belts.note: Coloured bell peppers for metros and hotels.

seasons.name: Southern plateau
seasons.note: Staggered plantings keep supply going most of the year.

lean_season: April–June, when plains crops end and hill crops have not started.

climate.v: Day 21–27 °C and nights 16–18 °C. Poor fruit set above ~32 °C or below ~15 °C.
Fruits sunscald in strong sun; shade nets common.
Even moisture; drip and mulch. Waterlogging brings Phytophthora.

weather_risks.impact: Flower drop and sunscald; the summer gap widens.
Phytophthora blight, fruit rot, road closures.
Misshapen fruit and slow growth in field crops.

pests.name: Phytophthora blight
pests.impact: Collar rot and fruit rot in wet soils.

postharvest.chilling: Chilling injury below ~7 °C: pitting and soft rot.
practices: Harvested firm and glossy; graded by size and shape (blocky fruit fetches more).
Coloured peppers are often stretch-wrapped or packed in punnets.
Shipped in crates or CFB boxes; holds up in transit better than leafy vegetables.

steps.what: Several pickings a week; polyhouse growers often sell to fixed buyers.
Chikkaballapur, Kolar, Solan auctions; agri-tech aggregators for coloured peppers.

supply_chain.farmer_share: Not estimated in the RBI series.

varieties.name: Arka Mohini, Arka Gaurav, Arka Basant
Red and yellow bell peppers (e.g. Bomby, Orobelle)

trade.exports: Small, to the Gulf, UK and Nepal.

policy.what: State and NHB subsidies for polyhouses have driven coloured-pepper growth.

history.what: Winter plains crop plus Karnataka supply pushes prices down.

signals: Arrivals at Chikkaballapur, Kolar and Solan.
Heat in Apr–Jun and rain in Jul–Sep over Karnataka and Himachal.
business: Food service is a big buyer; contract supply with spec grading suits capsicum well.
Coloured peppers are a polyhouse premium crop with steady metro demand.
Ships and stores better than most vegetables, which helps multi-city distribution.

institutes.name: Dr YS Parmar University of Horticulture and Forestry
